description: This file defines the 'LoanDisbursementDetails' class, representing details of a loan disbursement including dates, amount, and state, with persistence annotations. It includes methods for updating, copying, and converting to a data transfer object.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing details of a loan disbursement, including dates, principal amount, and reversal status. It provides methods to update, copy, compare, and convert disbursement data.

methods.name: updateLoan
methods.description: Associates the disbursement details with a specific Loan entity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare LoanDisbursementDetails instances based on principal and expected disbursement date.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on expectedDisbursementDate and principal.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LoanDisbursementDetails instance into this one.

methods.name: expectedDisbursementDateAsLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the expected disbursement date as a LocalDate object, null if not set.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Returns the principal amount for the disbursement.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the disbursement details into a DisbursementData transfer object.

methods.name: updateExpectedDisbursementDateAndAmount
methods.description: Updates the expected disbursement date and principal amount.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Checks if the disbursement has been reversed.
